description.narrative:
Support to the convening of the Third Small-Scale Fisheries Summit in 2026. The planned effect is Sustainable and equitable small-scale fisheries achieved, with small-scale fisheries organizations and communities empowered. The main outcome is that small-scale fisheries organizations are strengthened and empowered to better contribute to SSF Guidelines implementation for sustainable, resilient and equitable small-scale fisheries livelihoods. This support will ensure broad participation of small-scale fisheries representatives in the SSF Summit 2026.
This agreement is for covering primarily travel support for participants from ODA countries to attend the Small Scale Fisheries Summit. The purpose of the summit is to create a meeting platform for the Voluntary Guidelines for Small Scale Fisheries which are for securing rights of fishers and fish workers that operate on a small scale. 47% of this sector consists of women. The majority of participants will be small-scale fisheries representatives, reflecting a global regional balance and the representation of women, youth and Indigenous Peoples.
